School of Atmospheric Sciences · Nanjing University

Nanjing University Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory

Through self-developed fluid-dynamics apparatus and numerical models, we explore the fundamental dynamics of the atmosphere, oceans, and rotating stratified fluids.

2012 — 2026

NJU GFD LAB

Understanding geophysical flows from the laboratory bench

Founded by students in 2012 and formally established in 2014, the NJU GFD Lab is a hands-on research platform shaped and managed with active student participation. We design experimental apparatus, conduct fluid-dynamics experiments, and develop numerical models to investigate the physical mechanisms governing flows in the atmosphere, oceans, and rotating planetary systems.

Research directions
01

Laboratory Simulation of Tropical Cyclogenesis

Controlled fluid experiments are used to investigate the fundamental dynamical and thermodynamical processes involved in tropical cyclone formation.

02

Wave–Current Interaction

Laboratory experiments and numerical simulations are combined to study the fundamental interactions between waves and background flows.
